download_megadepth_dataset: download the MegaDepth dataset files to a specified target directory
extract_megadepth_archives: extract the downloaded MegaDepth tar.gz and tar.xz archive files
merge_megadepth_folders: merge the MegaDepth_v1 and MegaDepth_v1_SfM folders into a single combined megadepth folder
download_megadepth_pairs: download the MegaDepth pairs npz file to the combined megadepth folder
run_megadepth_download_cli: run the MegaDepth download script with argparse flags like --download-only or --merge-only
